# Code Anchors: Prose Translation

- `components/agents/nxs-prose.md` — the translator brief: the six form rules, the two content rules it is told are not its own, the density-finding line shape, the grounding rule with its contiguous-span test, the never-change list, and the fixed five-field receipt.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — the resident convention block, the pre-gate translate point on the epic draft, the feature navigation README translate point, and the verbatim-transcription rule binding each story body to the translated epic.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the resident convention and the record-body translate point, including the supersession prose on a revision.
- `components/commands/nxs.discover.md` — the resident convention; drafts to session scratch and writes the translated file into the committed store, so a failed check never leaves a bad file where the commit step expects a good one.
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — the grounding variant of the convention: names the epic and the resolved why file as sources on both the translator and the verifier, and requires standing density findings in the completion report.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — scaffolds the ignore rule for the pre-translation copy into a newly set-up project.
